problem.a: Yebo! Kuyinkinga enkulu, kodwa amaKristu amaningi awakwazi nhlobo ngoba aneBhayibheli noma angakwazi ukulifunda ku-inthanethi. Ngenxa yokuthi kulula kakhulu ukufunda iBhayibheli ku-inthanethi, umcabango uwukuthi iBhayibheli kumelwe kube lula ukulisebenzisa nokwabelana ngalo, akunjalo? Kodwa noma ubani oye wazama ukuthola ukufinyelela emiBhalweni ukuze **enze** okuthile (uhlelo lokusebenza, iwebhusayithi, inguqulo entsha yeBhayibheli, iBhayibheli elilalelwayo, njll.) uyazi ukuthi akunjalo. Futhi ezweni elidinga kakhulu ivangeli, lokhu akunasizathu nhlobo.

attribution.q: Yini engalungile ngokufuna abanye bathi ngumsunguli wenguqulo yeBhayibheli?
attribution.a: Ukucela i-abilitation kulungile. **Ukuyidinga** kunezela isimo somuntu ekudluliseleni izwi likaNkulunkulu. Noma ubani angase alikopishe, alihumushe, alibuyekeze, alivumelanise, futhi alisakaze, ngakho-ke silibheka njengelisebenzayo, kodwa alikwazi ukupha ngokukhululeka.

shareAlike.q: Ingabe ukwabelana ngokufana akuyona indlela enhle yokuvikela imiBhalo?
shareAlike.a: I-share-alike yakhiwe njengempendulo ku-copyright ukuze kuvinjelwe noma ubani othatha umbhalo ovulekile, awushintshe, futhi awuvale umphumela. Igcina zonke izindlela ezinhlanu zokusebenzisa (ukukopisha, ukuhumusha, ukubukeza, ukulungisa, nokusabalalisa) zivulekile, ngakho-ke sibheka ukuthi ziyasebenza. Kodwa isavimbela umsebenzi othembekile: umhumushi owakhela kumbhalo ofana nokwabelana akanakukhipha ukuhumusha kwakhe emphakathini. Kodwa singakhuthaza ukuthi i-copyright akuyona impendulo engcono kakhulu ku-copyright. Kunalokho, umgomo ophakeme kufanele ube yizinto ezisezingeni **eliphezulu** , zomphakathi kangangokuthi noma ubani angakwazi ukuzivumelanisa nanoma yini ayidingayo embusweni.

conditions.q: Kuthiwani uma ngisafuna ukubeka imibandela ekuhumusheni kwami?
conditions.a: Bese okungenani yenza kube lula ukwehluka. Shicilela ukuthi ungakufinyelela kanjani, uphendule ngokushesha, futhi unikeze ukwehluka kokusetshenziswa okuthembekile. Hlela ukuthi ubani ozophendula uma ungasakwazi, noma ukhulule umsebenzi wakho emphakathini lapho ushona. Uma ungakwazi ukuqhubeka nalokho, kukhulule manje. Zonke izicelo ezingaphendulwanga zivala umnyango wombuso, futhi ngisho no-yebo osheshayo uyamhluleka okholwayo ongakwazi ukubuza ngokuphephile esesimweni sokushushiswa.

money.q: Kodwa abahumushi beBhayibheli nabashicileli bazoyenza kanjani imali?

nonCommercial.q: Yini engalungile ngokudinga ukusetshenziswa okungeyona eyezentengiselwano?
nonCommercial.a: Amagama angewona awokuhweba avimbela umsebenzi wokwethembeka, ngakho siwabheka njengavinjelwe. Kunezindlela eziningi iBhayibheli elingasatshalaliswa ngazo ngokwezentengiselwano ngendlela emsulwa nethembekile (isibonelo, ukunyathelisa amaBhayibheli nokuwathengisa ngentengo edingekayo ukuze uthole inzuzo encane yokutshala imali kabusha ekusebenzeni nasekukhuliseni ukusatshalaliswa). Iphuzu, mKristu othandekayo, ukuthi **akuyona indawo yakho** ukutshela abanye ukuthi bangalisebenzisa kanjani izwi likaNkulunkulu nokuthi abakwazi kanjani.

fund.title: Isikhwama Sokusebenzisa Mahhala
fund.sub: Sethula isikhwama esisekelwe kumaphrojekthi ukuze siqalise uhlelo oluvulekile lobuKristu bomhlaba wonke.
fund.whatBody1: Umbono wethu uwuhlelo olukhulayo lwamaKristu akha izinsiza zomphakathi ezisezingeni eliphezulu kanye namathuluzi omthombo ovulekile emsebenzini womunye nomunye.
fund.whatBody2: Sixhasa ukuhumusha, amathuluzi, amasethi edatha, izimpahla, nanoma yini enye iSonto lomhlaba wonke elingayifaka noma lakhele kuyo, sibeka phambili amaphrojekthi anethonya elikhulu kakhulu. Sithanda okuqukethwe kwe-CC0 kanye nesofthiwe yomthombo ovulekile ngaphansi kwamalayisense afana ne-MIT noma i-AGPL. Ukukhishwa ngakunye kunikeza umakhi olandelayo okwengeziwe ukusebenza naye.
fund.overview: Funda ukubuka konke kweSikhwama Sokusetshenziswa Kwamahhala
fund.statusBody: Umgomo wokusekela waminyaka yonke we-AO Lab ongu- {{ goal }} awukafinyelelwa, ngakho-ke iSikhwama Sokusebenzisa Mahhala asinayo imali okwamanje. Ungabuka isimo sokusekela samanje {{ here }} .
fund.callIntro: Amaphrojekthi amasha kanye nomsebenzi osuqalile kokubili kwamukelekile. Sincoma izicelo ezimfushane neziqondile ezinemininingwane emincane. Sizoxhumana nathi ukuthola ulwazi olwengeziwe.

fund.reportingBody: Sizoshicilela ukusetshenziswa kwemali kanye nezibuyekezo zephrojekthi lapha, okuhlanganisa nomsebenzi oqhubekayo. Amaphrojekthi aqediwe azoshicilelwa futhi amenyezelwe njengoba eseqediwe.

who.a: Noma ubani emphakathini jikelele, okuhlanganisa abantu ngabanye nezinhlangano. Chaza ukuthi yini ofuna ukuyakha, amalayisense ayo ahlongozwayo, nokuthi kungani kubalulekile ohlelweni oluvulekile olukhonza ubuKristu bomhlaba wonke.

early.q: Kungani uthumela ngaphambi kokuba imali itholakale?
early.a: Iziphakamiso zakho ziyasisiza ukuthi sibone izidingo futhi zibonise ukuthi yiluphi usizo olungenza kube nokwenzeka. Zingasisiza ukuthi siphakamise ukwesekwa kwe-AO Lab kanye nomphakathi wonke, futhi zisinike amaphrojekthi okufanele siwacabangele lapho uxhaso selutholakala.

decides.q: Ubani onquma ukuthi yimaphi amaphrojekthi athola uxhaso?
decides.a: I-AO Lab iphatha isikhwama futhi ikhetha amaphrojekthi ngomthelela wawo olindelekile wombuso kanye nenzuzo eBandleni elibanzi. Amaphrojekthi angaba makhulu noma amancane, kubekwe phambili umsebenzi umphakathi omkhulu ongawusebenzisa futhi wakhe kuwo.

staff.q: Ingabe abasebenzi be-AO Lab bangafaka izicelo?
staff.a: Yebo. Noma ubani wamukelekile ukufaka isicelo, okuhlanganisa nabasebenzi be-AO Lab, futhi sixhasa amaphrojekthi esikholelwa ukuthi azothuthukisa umbuso kangcono. Lesi sikhwama senzelwe ukukhulisa uhlelo olubanzi lwezemvelo ngale kwethimba lethu, ngakho-ke ukukhetha kwethu okukhulu ukuxhasa ngemali yangaphandle. Silindele ukuthi ukuxhaswa kwabasebenzi kube kuncane, kodwa ngeke sikulahle uma othile eqenjini lethu engumuntu ongcono kakhulu wephrojekthi enomthelela omkhulu.

commission.q: Ingabe ikhomishini ye-AO Lab ihlela noma iqhuba imicimbi?
commission.a: Yebo. Kanye neziphakamiso ezivulekile, singase sibone izikhala ezibalulekile ohlelweni lwe-ecosystem bese simema abantu abanekhono noma amaqembu ukuthi bazithathe. Njengoba isikhwama sikhula, singase futhi sibeke u-5% kuya ku-10% kuma-hackathon, imiklomelo, kanye nama-sprints okubambisana aletha abakhi abasha emsebenzini futhi akhiqize izinsiza ezingasetshenziswa kabusha ngokukhululeka. Leso yisiqondiso, hhayi isabelo: lapho amaphrojekthi afanele edinga uxhaso, imali iya kumaphrojekthi.

money.a: Njalo ngoSepthemba, siqala ukuqoqa ukwesekwa kwaminyaka yonke kwe-AO Lab konyaka olandelayo. Uma lowo mgomo usufeziwe, lonke ukwesekwa okwengeziwe kuya eSikhwameni Sokusetshenziswa Kwamahhala kuze kube uSepthemba olandelayo, lapho umjikelezo uqala futhi.

licences.a: Sikhetha amagama avumela kakhulu ngangokunokwenzeka, nge-CC0 njengefanele okuqukethwe okufana nokuhumusha, amasethi edatha, kanye nezimpahla. Isofthiwe ingasebenzisa i-MIT, i-AGPL, noma amanye amalayisense omthombo ovulekile. Sibuyekeza ilayisensi yesofthiwe icala ngalinye, sicabangela ukuthi isekela kahle kangakanani ukusetshenziswa kabusha kanye nesistimu ebanzi. Bhala amalayisense akho aphakanyisiwe esiphakamisweni sakho.

translation.q: Ingabe lesi sikhwama singasekela ukuhunyushwa kweBhayibheli?
translation.a: Yebo. Inguqulo yeBhayibheli ye-CC0 ingacatshangelwa kanye nezinye izinsiza kanye namathuluzi omthombo ovulekile. Sihlola amaphrojekthi ngomthelela wawo wombuso kanye nenzuzo ehlanganyelwe, kunokunikeza uhlobo olulodwa lomsebenzi kuqala ngokuzenzakalela.

progress.q: Ngingalandela kuphi ukusetshenziswa kwemali kanye nenqubekela phambili yephrojekthi?
progress.a: Kuleli khasi. Izibuyekezo zekota zizobonisa ukuthi imali isetshenziswe kanjani nokuthi imaphi amaphrojekthi asekelwe, okuhlanganisa nomsebenzi ongaqedwanga. Amaphrojekthi aqediwe azoshicilelwa futhi amenyezelwe njengoba eseqediwe.

public.q: Ingabe imininingwane yephrojekthi ngayinye izoba semphakathini?
public.a: Okuwukuphela komehluko emininingwaneni ephelele yephrojekthi ukuphepha: singase sigodle ulwazi olungabeka abantu abasebenza ezindaweni ezishushiswayo engozini. Ukubika kwekota kuzoqhubeka, imininingwane ebucayi igodliwe lapho kudingeka khona. Abaxhasi bamukelekile ku- {{ contact }} ukuzoxoxa ngalokho okungabiwa ngokuphephile.
